regions.text: 一つの同時約偶然には相達ないがそれだけの單獨の事實としては殆ど注目に價しないものである。

quote.translation: That the Kantō earthquake occurred on 1 September, that is, on a day whose month and day add up to ten, is certainly a simultaneous contingency, but as a single isolated fact it hardly deserves notice.

regions.text: それに反して「月目の合計数が拾となる日附に震災が起ろ」といふ單一の偶然が同一性を以て数同に互つて繰返されるときそこに繼起的偶然性がかなり強い印象力をもつて構成されて來るのである。

quote.translation: When, on the other hand, the single contingent "an earthquake occurs on a date whose month and day add up to ten" is repeated several times with identity, a successive contingency of fairly strong impressive force is constituted.

regions.text: また假に或る人が月の四日に旅立つたとする。汽車に乗るとき停車場のプラットフォームが第四號プラットフォームであつたとする。乗つた車がたまたま第四號車であつた。

quote.translation: Again, suppose that someone sets out on a journey on the fourth of the month, that when he boards the train it leaves from platform no. 4, that the carriage he boards happens to be carriage no. 4, that his fellow passengers number four in all, and that the porter's number is also 4.

regions.text: 同乘姿が合計四人であつた。赤幅の番織も四番であつたとする。この場合、「甲なる人が四といふ数にぶつかる」といふことは印象力の微弱な偶然である。その單一の同時的個然が數回に亙つて機起的に繰返されるところに彼然が十分な印象力を具現して成立するのである。

quote.translation: In this case "person A runs into the number four" is something contingent of weak impressive force, but where that single simultaneous contingency is repeated in succession several times, the contingent is constituted, embodying sufficient impressive force.

regions.text: 従つて期やうに一つの同時的偶然だけでは微弱な力よう有たないで数同繰返されてはじめて機起的偶然をして有力なものとなる場合には、偶然の織起性が比較獨立な意味

quote.translation: In cases like this, then, where a single simultaneous contingency has only weak force and becomes forceful as a successive contingency only when it has been repeated several times, it cannot be denied that the successiveness of the contingent acquires a relatively independent meaning.

regions.text: 有つて来ることは否み得ないが、しかもなほ機起偶然の成立する不可鉄條件はその個々の事象が同時的偶然であることである。

quote.translation: Even so, the indispensable condition for a successive contingency to be constituted remains that each of its individual events be a simultaneous contingency.

regions.text: 若しすべての因子にそれ自身の

quote.translation: If all the factors lacked any contingency of their own, no successive contingency could be constituted.
